notes.title: 🧴 Useful gestures #01 - Plastics & Seashells 🐚
notes.content:
Hello Ocean friends,

Dolphin Spirit - Ocean Mission will see you help the environment association of Mauripoa to fight pollution on the island... But you can already help protect our oceans and beaches in real life, even while on holiday!

Mind your plastic 🧴

Plastic trash is a big threat to marine life for many reasons. “New” garbage can go as far as killing animals (sea turtles, for instance, can choke on plastic bags they mistook for a jellyfish), but it also changes their behaviors and alters the undersea chemistry. Their presence allows microbes, seaweed and other nasty things to develop and weaken the seafloor. In addition, plastic ends up breaking down into nanoparticles that get ingested by fish, slowly but surely poisoning the whole ecosystem as they make their way up the food chain.
To help prevent such a disaster, don’t forget to collect all your trash, and don’t hesitate to pick up any plastic garbage you may spot on the beach.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974818/aed6e2e2bcbeb7b88a84660ab8333332cac1018f.gif

Leave them be 🐚

Beaches are rich with various seashells and shingles that look like the perfect souvenir…! However, they are first and foremost a vital part of the coastal ecosystem: not only do they regulate the acidity of the water, they also bring essential minerals to marine wildlife. Taking one home might not seem like a big deal, but for the sea it means losing a lot.
